settings.title: Sync server
settings.description: Address of the server this device signs in to

settings.title: Sync interval
settings.description: How often this device asks the server for changes

settings.title: Removal delay
settings.description: How long a removed file is watched before the removal is sent

settings.title: Epoch root key
settings.description: Public root key (64 hex digits) that vouches for restore announcements of a server you typed above; it never counts for the default server

settings.title: Folder for shared vaults
settings.description: Where the folders shared with you are kept
settings.details: Where the folders shared with you are kept. Empty means Numen Shared in your home folder.

settings.title: Sync only while the app is open
settings.description: Stops the sync while the app is off the screen
settings.details: Stops the sync when the app leaves the screen and starts it when it returns.
